sentences.c: After that the doctors told him he couldn't play sports any more, but there was one good side effect: his new-found skill.
sentences.cn: 在那之后，医生告诉他，他不能再参加运动了，但有一个很好的副作用：他的新技能。

sentences.c: Sometimes when you take a common drug, you may have a side effect.
sentences.cn: 有时当你服用一种普通药物时，可能会有副作用。

sentences.cn: 那男孩当时在受肠梗阻之苦。

sentences.c: The blade missed his kidney, but went into his bowel.
sentences.cn: 刀片没刺中他的肾脏，但却扎进了他的肠子。

sentences.c: Symptoms such as stomach pains and irritable bowels can be signs of bowel cancer.
sentences.cn: 胃痛和肠易激等症状都可能是肠癌的征兆。

sentences.cn: 谁会反对母性与家庭的温馨呢？

sentences.cn: 共和党母性理论的引入戏剧性地改变了史学。

sentences.c: According to Kerber, motherhood became pivotal to the fate of the republic, providing justification for an unprecedented attention to female education.
sentences.cn: 根据 Kerber 的说法，母性成为了共和国命运的关键，这为前所未有的女性教育关注提供了辩护。

sentences.cn: 她的汽车撞毁了一辆面包车的尾部。

sentences.cn: 自己是否作好了为人父母的准备，人人都会感到疑虑。

sentences.cn: 她可能觉得还没有准备好担当人母的责任。

sentences.c: As working from home becomes increasingly common, people are finding it easier to combine parenthood with a full-time career.
sentences.cn: 随着在家工作变得越来越普遍，人们发现为人父母与全职工作相结合变得越来越容易。
